mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP3A4, reducing quetiapine metabolism and increasing quetiapine plasma concentrations; opposing CNS effects (quetiapine sedating vs modafinil stimulating) create pharmacodynamic conflict.
action: Monitor for increased quetiapine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, QT prolongation); consider quetiapine dose reduction and assess therapeutic efficacy of both agents.
